name: Default
shortDescription: Apache Solr search platform built on Lucene, running a single user-managed node with basic authentication, a precreated core and persistent index storage.

alerts.message: The Admin UI and API require basic authentication: log in as user admin with the generated SOLR_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment variables. The credentials are written to security.json on first start only; to change the password later use the Solr authentication API, then set SOLR_ADMIN_PASSWORD to the new value so the health check keeps passing.
